needs.text: Whether Jagdish Singh sub-let, assigned, or otherwise parted with possession of the disputed premises to Harbir Singh.
How competing evidence bears on exclusive versus retained possession.
Whether the alleged 1988 parting occurred without written landlord consent and within the statutory time scope.
Whether Harbir Singh's family connection, permitted residence, and asserted absence of rent support permissive occupation rather than subletting.
How to preserve the ARC and ARCT findings at their lower-court levels and respect authority scope at the target review stage.
